name: Bucketlist.nl Dream of the Day Public API
free_limit: Public JSON API with CORS serving a daily rotating activity/experience idea, image, canonical URL and source attribution; no published request quota.
watch_out: Public API currently needs no account, API key or card, but no formal request rate limit, SLA, service permanence or commercial-content reuse license is published. Keep source attribution and the canonical URL; linked destinations can contain affiliate offers. Daily content rotation is not a one-request/day allowance.
